system.description:
Imbued with the Threne of the Chameleon. Counts as a 4D Threne of the Chameleon: when using Stealthy and/or the Threne, add the cloak’s dice to the skill or song when rolling to hide. Warm in winter, cool in summer, covering in rain and quick to dry.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 157
